provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, section 5.3 (merge_keys = Apply).

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Pairs of inputs that differ only in whether the merge source is an alias or an inline mapping, at 1 to 1000 source entries: the directive before and after a shadowing explicit key, and a sequence of two overlapping sources. Both inputs of a pair have the same expected value; their budgets are measured, not expected. Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
